decisions.reason: As a tool tightly linked to the firm's hosting and support capabilities, Product D likely meets at least a satisfactory aspiration level and, with industry growth and some organisational slack, does not yet trigger problemistic search strong enough to justify withdrawal.

As a close-to-core, multi-model flagship offer for agencies, Product F fits the firm's stated direction and key resources so well that management would be likely to retain it unless performance fell clearly below aspiration levels.
